title: Presence of per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in brain samples of marine mammals from the St. Lawrence Estuary and Gulf, Canada
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00061K, Paper
Open Access

Nejumal Kannankeril Khalid, Amira Aker, Stéphane Lair, Sébastien Sauvé
We present data on the moderate bioaccumulation of PFAS in the brain tissues of sea mammals, an important milestone to evaluate potential neurocognitive impacts of PFAS.
